subject: design/local-execution-logs
statement: Pyxis CLI journals live under .pyxis/logs/cli in the target repository. Source and installer root ignore rules exclude .pyxis/logs, and the shipped .pyxis/.gitignore gives existing installations the same exclusion through convergence. Release staging excludes the tree even when a file was force-tracked. Admission and adoption disregard retained diagnostics when assessing an otherwise empty initialization target.
intent: Preserve failed-initialization diagnostics and allow a safe retry while preventing local output from entering commits, another user's clone, or release archives.
rationale: Logging before initialization leaves a nonempty directory after failure. Treating that diagnostic directory as project content would block retry or alter adoption mode. Delivering a nested ignore rule lets upgrades protect logs while preserving operator-owned root ignore configuration.
fit_criterion: Installed-flow tests cover initialization, rollback, retry, and convergence exclusions. Real Git tests retain historical records and shared workitems in a second clone while excluding all log subdirectories. Release tests reject log payload entries.

provenance.note: Records log exclusion delivery and initialization lifecycle handling.
